refuter_findings.location: Definition, first paragraph: graph distance dΓ
refuter_findings.evidence: The Definition allows a “finite undirected graph Γ=(X,EΓ)” and names “the graph distance dΓ,” then requires A_xy=0 when dΓ(x,y)>1. It neither requires Γ to be connected nor defines the distance for disconnected pairs, so that condition is undefined for allowed inputs.

refuter_findings.location: Definition, positive heavy-scalar Gaussian submodel paragraph: ν_H
refuter_findings.evidence: The general record allows any “specified Borel probability measure ν_H on ℝ^X.” The Gaussian submodel adds A and K but never requires ν_H to be the centered Gaussian with covariance K⁻¹. For example, with X={1}, A=0, M=1, and K=1, the allowed choice ν_H=(δ₋₁+δ₁)/2 satisfies the stated measure condition but is not N₁(0,1).

refuter_findings.location: Definition, final paragraph on the one-particle-irreducible effective action
refuter_findings.evidence: The Definition says, “A one-particle-irreducible effective action, when it exists, is the Legendre transform of a connected source-generating functional for the retained fields.” It supplies no source or field spaces, pairing, sign convention, or conditions defining that transform; the aside uses these technical terms without an exact earlier definition.

reader_findings.location: Definition, first paragraph: graph distance d_Γ and its use in the Gaussian submodel
reader_findings.evidence: The finite undirected graph is not required to be connected, but d_Γ is only named as graph distance. The later condition A_xy=0 when d_Γ(x,y)>1 is undefined for disconnected pairs. Define extended shortest-path distance with value +∞, or restrict the graph to be connected.

reader_findings.location: Definition, positive heavy-scalar Gaussian submodel paragraph: operator norm, P_E, and J(ℓ)
reader_findings.evidence: The item uses ‖A‖ and calls P_E an orthogonal spectral projection without specifying the Euclidean structure or complexification, and does not state how the spectral-measure construction in its QFT-unit supplier applies to the real matrix A; it also does not type J as a map from retained-coordinate space. The exact inner product, A_ℂ, PVM use, and source-map domain are needed to make these data precise.

reader_findings.location: Definition, positive heavy-scalar Gaussian submodel paragraph: ν_H
reader_findings.evidence: The general model record leaves ν_H as any specified Borel probability, and the Gaussian submodel adds A and K but never requires ν_H to be a centered Gaussian probability with covariance K⁻¹. That measure law is needed to define the advertised Gaussian submodel and match its stated kernel.

The integral exponent requires dimensionless S_UV. The definition calls S_UV a real Borel ultraviolet action but does not state that it is normalized as the physical action divided by ℏ; natural-unit notation alone does not identify that normalization.

reader_findings.location: Definition, final paragraph on the one-particle-irreducible effective action
reader_findings.evidence: The paragraph identifies the 1PI action only as a Legendre transform of a connected source-generating functional. It gives no source and field spaces, pairing, sign convention, or differentiability/invertibility conditions defining that transform. Supply an exact convention or remove the aside.
